ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two vertical straight lines, and they carry parallel marks in the same direction, indicating that these two vertical lines are parallel. A slanted line below slopes downward from left to right, and intersects the two vertical parallel lines respectively; near the left intersection ∠1 is marked, and near the right intersection ∠5 is marked. The problem text gives m∠1 = 123, and asks to find m∠5. Reasoning: Regard the slanted line below as a transversal cutting these two parallel vertical lines. ∠1 is located outside the left vertical line and below the transversal, and ∠5 is located outside the right vertical line and above the transversal; they are a pair of alternate exterior angles in a corresponding-position structure with opposite inside-outside directions, namely alternate exterior angles. When parallel lines are cut by a transversal, alternate exterior angles are equal, so m∠5 = m∠1 = 123.

method.method_draft: Identify from the image that the two vertical lines are marked parallel, and the lower slanted line intersects both of them. Read from the text that m∠1 = 123 and the target is ∠5. Treat the lower slanted line as a transversal of the parallel vertical lines: ∠1 and ∠5 occupy alternate exterior positions, so they are congruent. Therefore m∠5 = 123.
